question: In an activated sludge plant, what is the main role of the microorganisms in the aeration basin?
correctAnswer: They break down dissolved and colloidal organic matter in the wastewater

They settle grit and sand out of the raw wastewater
They disinfect the final effluent before discharge
They screen rags and large debris from the influent
